project_type: Next.js 15 (App Router) demo web app — client-rendered interactive prototype with mock data, no backend/DB/auth. Dark navy design-system UI optimized for a 1920x1080 presentation screen.
build_system: npm + Next.js build (next build). Path alias '@/*' resolves to the project root (see tsconfig.json). Tailwind 3.4 with PostCSS + autoprefixer. QUIRK: node_modules is NOT installed yet — run 'npm install' once before the first build.
test_framework: No unit-test framework is configured. Verification is the production build (next build, which type-checks with strict TS and runs ESLint via eslint-config-next) plus manual 'npm run dev' click-through for interactive screens.
test_command: npm run build  (there is no separate test runner; next build is the gate)
verification_instructions: 1) From the project root run 'npm install' (first time only). 2) Run 'npm run build' and confirm it exits 0 with no TypeScript or ESLint errors. 3) For interactive screens, run 'npm run dev', open http://localhost:3000, and click through the relevant route; confirm the behavior and watch the browser console for React hydration or runtime warnings (there should be none).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. next build writes .next/ which is gitignored; do not commit it.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell (pwsh). All timers (setTimeout/setInterval) must live inside useEffect with cleanup on unmount. Anything time-based or random must render identically on server and first client paint to avoid hydration mismatches — follow the existing pattern in lib/utils.ts formatDateTime, which pins locale 'en-US' and timeZone 'UTC'. Prefer hand-rolled SVG/CSS for charts and the network map rather than adding chart dependencies, to keep 'npm install' minimal and code readable for a high-school team.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md/.kiro steering files exist in this project. Keep code clean, well-organized, and commented so the Vanguard IV team can understand and modify it. Reuse the existing component primitives and the Tailwind palette tokens instead of introducing new colors or libraries. Do NOT add a database, auth, or real network/AI calls — simulate with timeouts/intervals and pre-determined mock results. Each FEAT commits locally on the current branch; never push.
key_patterns: Server/client split: each route's page.tsx is a server component that owns 'metadata' and wraps content in <AppShell>; interactivity lives in a sibling '*Client.tsx' marked 'use client'. Shared UI primitives live in components/. Domain types in lib/types.ts; presentation helpers (cn, formatDateTime, severityStyle, scoreTone) in lib/utils.ts; all mock data in data/mock.ts. Tailwind palette tokens: navy / navy-light / navy-lighter, teal (accent, == cyan), emerald (safe), amber (warning), threat (danger). Use the cn() helper for conditional classes. A reusable Toggle switch pattern already exists inside app/privacy-center/PrivacyCenterClient.tsx.

directory_structure: app/ holds App Router routes (one folder per screen, each with page.tsx and optional *Client.tsx) plus layout.tsx, page.tsx (landing), globals.css. components/ holds reusable UI. data/mock.ts holds all mock datasets. lib/ holds types.ts and utils.ts.
